S18 is done: a `**Settles:**` label now counts as a change for UNMARKED_CHANGE. Your unit tests pass, `gov accept W2-129` gives 156 passed and 0 failed, and on this repository the `--all` count goes from 1,404 to 1,405, with only the one `**Settles:**` pair added.

**Sandbox check (Step 0):**
- (a) The write outside the worktree failed: `OSError: [Errno 30] Read-only file system`.
- (b) `git hash-object -w --stdin` worked (`1ae28402a109…`) and so did `git update-index --refresh`.

- **task:** W2-129 (DAEO-q7lk), S18: a settlement is a change.
- **status:** DONE
- **work_completed:**
  - `check.py`: `CHANGE_CLASSES` now holds `("supersede", "amend", "settle")`.
  - **One departure from the brief's wording:** a new `SETTLES_FORM = "**Settles:**"` limits `settle` to the label.
    - The brief speaks of everything the loader classes `settle`. The loader also gives that class to a free-text "settled by".
    - Counting the free-text form added a second pair, DEC-763 ← DEC-762. It comes from DEC-763's body ("P-4 is settled by DEC-762 item 3"), which settles a package item, not the entry. The brief asks that only `**Settles:**` pairs be added, so I left the free form out.
  - A settlement is never whole. Its finding reads `DEC-x <- DEC-y (**Settles:**; part)`, with `ids` in (changed, changer) order as for an amendment, and its mark is `**Changed by:** DEC-y`.
  - A PROPOSED, REJECTED or WITHDRAWN settler gives nothing, through the existing `NOT_A_CHANGER` check.
- **files_changed:** `src/gov/links/check.py`, `tests/unit/links/test_links.py`, `docs/research/W2-129-links.md` (new §10 and an S18 row in §7).
- **evidence:**
  - The `--all --json` runs before and after went through `heavy_slot.sh`, as did the unit and accept runs.
  - The new unit case fails with the old `CHANGE_CLASSES` (`len(found) == 0`) and passes with the change.
  - The register's 4 `**Settles:**` labels give 5 pairs. DEC-026 ← DEC-086 is the only new finding; the other 4 settled entries already name their settler on their status line.
  - Scratch space used: 1.1 MB in `/tmp/gov-launch-5xxq0i0u/s18` and 288 KB in TMPDIR.
- **tests:**
  - `tests/unit/links`: 70 passed (66 before plus 4 new cases).
  - The new case is `test_s18_a_settles_label_is_a_change_as_an_amendment`, run for ACCEPTED, PROPOSED, REJECTED and WITHDRAWN.
  - The required exclusion (`-m "not local_only" -k "not real and not green_here and not time_limit"`) left out nothing in this folder.
- **discoveries:**
  - DEC-056 ← DEC-017 is still listed as an UNMARKED_CHANGE, although §8 of the record says it was dropped because DEC-017 is PROPOSED. DEC-017's status may have changed since then. I did not chase it; it is outside S18.
  - The first `gov accept` run crashed (exit 4, every line empty) because the scratch HOME had an empty `.local` folder rather than a link. After linking `~/.local` in, it passed.
- **risks:** if the designer's interface line was meant to cover the free-text "settled by" as well, the `SETTLES_FORM` check is the one line to remove. That would add DEC-763 ← DEC-762.
- **lessons:** the scratch HOME needs `.local` as a link, not an empty folder, or `gov accept` crashes with no detail.
